note: The transcriptions read in reader/, one per copy (item of the catalogue) they were made on. copies: the items of the catalogue that show this same scan (the own item included, also one not in the catalogue yet), each with its offset: canvas number (#p, from 1) = page of the transcription + offset. released: the catalogue shows the link to everybody (false: only to admins; the reader still opens for anyone with a direct link). ink: how the viewer frees the writing from the paper (paper and ink: grey values; red: drop Durand's red Quốc Ngữ).
